title: Curtain Wall Mullion Profile Editor
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive curtain wall mullion profile editor for architectural facade design.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use an orthographic camera looking at the XY plane, with zoom controls. Initial camera zoom level = 1.0, positioned at (0, 0, 10) looking at origin.
- Background color #1a1a2e. Add a subtle grid helper on the XY plane (size 20, divisions 40, colors #333355 and #222244).
- Ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (5, 5, 10) with intensity 0.8.
- The mullion profile is a 2D cross-section shape extruded along the Z-axis. The default profile is a standard I-beam shape.

DEFAULT I-BEAM MULLION PROFILE (all units in cm):
- Total height (flangeHeight): 15.0 cm
- Flange width (flangeWidth): 8.0 cm
- Web thickness (webThickness): 1.5 cm
- Flange thickness (flangeThickness): 2.0 cm
- The profile is centered at origin. The I-beam consists of top flange, bottom flange, and connecting web.
- Extrusion depth: 30 cm along Z-axis.
- Material: MeshStandardMaterial with color #7088a0, metalness 0.6, roughness 0.3.

PROFILE EDITING SYSTEM:
- The profile has 8 control points (draggable handles) displayed as small spheres (radius 0.3, color #ff4466) on the XY plane at the corners of the I-beam cross-section.
- Control point layout (from default I-beam):
  CP0: top-left of top flange (-4, 7.5)
  CP1: top-right of top flange (4, 7.5)
  CP2: inner-left of top flange (-0.75, 5.5)
  CP3: inner-right of top flange (0.75, 5.5)
  CP4: inner-left of bottom flange (-0.75, -5.5)
  CP5: inner-right of bottom flange (0.75, -5.5)
  CP6: bottom-left of bottom flange (-4, -7.5)
  CP7: bottom-right of bottom flange (4, -7.5)
- Users can click and drag control points on the XY plane to reshape the profile. When a control point moves, the extruded mesh regenerates in real-time.
- Highlight the hovered control point by changing its color to #ffff00. The selected (being dragged) point turns #00ff88.

SYMMETRY MODE:
- A toggle button 'Symmetry: ON' / 'Symmetry: OFF' in the top-right corner. Default is ON.
- When symmetry is ON, moving a left-side point mirrors the X coordinate to its paired right-side point (pairs: CP0<->CP1, CP2<->CP3, CP4<->CP5, CP6<->CP7). The Y coordinate is copied identically.

PROFILE PRESETS:
- Three buttons in the top-left: 'I-Beam', 'T-Profile', 'Box-Profile'.
- I-Beam: default shape as described above.
- T-Profile: Only top flange + web, bottom flange points collapse to web width. CP6=(-0.75, -7.5), CP7=(0.75, -7.5).
- Box-Profile: Rectangular hollow section. CP2=(-3.0, 5.5), CP3=(3.0, 5.5), CP4=(-3.0, -5.5), CP5=(3.0, -5.5). Outer corners same as I-beam.

MEASUREMENTS & PROPERTIES:
- Display a HUD panel (bottom-left, semi-transparent dark background) showing:
  - 'Profile Height: XX.X cm' (distance from lowest to highest Y of control points)
  - 'Profile Width: XX.X cm' (distance from leftmost to rightmost X of control points)
  - 'Cross-Section Area: XX.XX cm²' (computed area of the 2D profile polygon)
  - 'Active Preset: I-Beam|T-Profile|Box-Profile|Custom'
- When any control point is manually moved away from a preset configuration, the preset label changes to 'Custom'.

EXTRUSION DEPTH SLIDER:
- A labeled slider in the bottom-right: 'Extrusion Depth' range 5-100 cm, default 30. Changing it regenerates the mesh.

KEYBOARD CONTROLS:
- 'R' key: Reset to default I-beam profile.
- '+'/'-' keys: Zoom camera in/out (adjust orthographic camera zoom by ±0.1, clamp 0.3 to 5.0).
- 'G' key: Toggle grid visibility.
- 'W' key: Toggle wireframe mode on the mullion mesh.

CROSS-SECTION AREA CALCULATION:
- Use the Shoelace formula on the profile polygon vertices to compute area. The I-beam polygon vertices go: CP0 -> CP1 -> CP3 -> CP5 -> CP7 -> CP6 -> CP4 -> CP2 -> back to CP0 (outer boundary of the I-shape).

STATE MANAGEMENT - Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
{
  controlPoints: [{x, y}, ...] // 8 control points current positions
  selectedPointIndex: number|null // index of currently dragged point, null if none
  hoveredPointIndex: number|null // index of hovered point
  symmetryEnabled: boolean
  activePreset: string // 'I-Beam', 'T-Profile', 'Box-Profile', 'Custom'
  extrusionDepth: number // current depth in cm
  profileHeight: number // computed height
  profileWidth: number // computed width
  crossSectionArea: number // computed area in cm²
  cameraZoom: number // current orthographic camera zoom
  gridVisible: boolean
  wireframeEnabled: boolean
  meshVertexCount: number // vertex count of the extruded mesh
  meshGenerated: boolean // true after first mesh generation
}

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop. Ensure all numerical values are never NaN or Infinity.
physics_constraints: Profile dimensions must remain positive (height > 0, width > 0). Control points must maintain valid I-beam topology (top flange Y > bottom flange Y, web points between flanges). Cross-section area must always be positive and computed via Shoelace formula. Symmetry mode must enforce exact X-mirroring (paired points have equal absolute X values). Extrusion depth must stay within [5, 100] range.
